Seconding your +1, but I assumed the dialogue was wacky on purpose, due to their otherworldly nature.

Still a +1, though; I had my annual Halloween viewing of Scream and I got fun horror-shivers at the party murders.

(That sounds bad out of context but you know what I mean)

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Hesitant +1

The overall tone is effectively haunting and leaves enough questions that I guarantee I’ll be thinking about it later… but the dialogue is fairly stilted (the way these teenagers talk is wooden) and the pacing leaves something to be desired. Towards the end the narration seems more tell than show, clearly spelling out why the three should be suspect. I think a subtler hand would be better there, personally.

But again, overall effective and spooky. +1
